source_set_format: sha256 two spaces leaf-relative file LF, sorted over five files_sha256; report/log excluded

scope.implementation: Original new registry layer over unchanged original BFD fake DART and BMI fake interrupt sources. No upstream source acquisition, no GPL or ISC implementation copied, no platform ownership-plan implementation.
scope.canonical_registry: Exactly one cooperative registry per fake endpoint. Caller serializes all users and must not bypass it with direct old APIs or create a second registry. This is not concurrent/thread-safe kernel ownership or a C security boundary.
scope.lifetime: Caller owns disjoint stable registry/handles/policy/ordinary table backing/staging/accessor/outputs. Active handles cannot move/copy; copied handles fail owner pointer checks. No allocation or asynchronous callbacks.
scope.stream: One live exact RID0x100/SID0..15 binding. A second map refuses even with another SID, preventing ambiguous bindings for the single requester.
scope.vectors: Eight independent exclusive vector slots0..7, backed by unchanged BMI one-bit allocated/masked source semantics. No invented T8103 MSI layout.
scope.reuse: Successful close releases the registry slot for a fresh owner. Closed handles and registries cannot reopen; no idempotent fake-success close.
scope.registry_close: Requires all mapping/vector slots empty; never implicitly closes or discards another owner.

dart_cleanup.healthy_close: After fresh PHY/link/identity guard, zero mapped fake root/leaf table bytes, clear image/tables/mapped state, release claim and mark wrapper closed. Retain caller storage pointers and historical commit count; no free.
dart_cleanup.fault_policy: Active-map guard/helper I/O errors, invalid table encodings and topology corruption latch map.faulted. Later map/translate/close all refuse BFO_FAULTED without reads, retry, fault clear or claim release. Backing retained. Original errors preserved on the first failure.
dart_cleanup.failed_open: No claim committed before complete admission; failed staged open leaves registry/output unchanged.
dart_cleanup.staging: Existing BFD helper operates on extra caller-owned inactive table staging because its own guard is link-only. Final new PHY/link/identity check precedes owned-table copy; internal image pointer rebound to stable destination.
dart_cleanup.translation: Uses unchanged validator/codec and requester checks; local PA staging and final guard preserve output on refusal.
dart_cleanup.not_claimed: No DART registers, cache maintenance, invalidation, IOTLB ACK, DMA/IRQ quiescence, device isolation or physical safe-free.

interrupt_cleanup.pending_masked_policy: Pending coalesced bits prevent close even if masked. An unmasked empty source also refuses. Explicit fake unmask/dispatch/mask steps required; no event discarded during close.
interrupt_cleanup.down_or_reset: Close and every other operation refuse with no registry/source/output/table changes at initial down/reset; vector remains owned.
interrupt_cleanup.staging: BMI operations run on a private synchronous copy; a final guard precedes source/output/claim updates. Read error or late reset preserves pending/mask/owner state.
interrupt_cleanup.not_claimed: No hardware MSI store, AIC registration, IRQ handler, actual pending ACK or physical drain.

gates.readiness: Bound checked fake accessor; initial PHY masked0x8f equals0x0f, portRUN, linkUP/notBUSY/notL2, synthetic PCI14e4:4425, final PHY recheck. Existing lower helpers remain unchanged.
gates.initial_not_ready: All11 operations refuse before observable owner/registry/table/workspace/output changes. Zero register writes under all tested conditions, healthy or not.
gates.late_failures: No owned-table/interrupt/output commit after the final guard refuses. Private inactive staging may change after initially healthy admission; DART I/O faults retain their sticky metadata fact. Serialized fake model, not atomic hardware exclusion.
gates.default_kernel: All11 operations return BFO_GATED with zero I/O or object/output changes. KERNEL here is a host compile gate, not SDK evidence.
gates.gpio_smc: Existing GPIO152 and SMC radio helpers remain compiled out and are never called by the new implementation.

validation.mutation_rule: Unmodified baseline compiles/runs first. Counted mutants compile then fail assertions; compile errors are not counted.

initial_failed_check.cause: Functional/fault/mutant cases passed; default source-shape assertion mistakenly matched bfd_storage type as a function call. Changed to function-call regex, preserving failed log.

intermediate_pass.scope: Before final test refinement to use a genuinely fresh owner object instead of zeroing a retired test handle; complete frozen suite rerun afterward.

validation.fixture: Exact prior fake IRQ register backend included with its main renamed and not run. No old test, hardware survey or receipt regenerated.
validation.repository_checks: Bounded focused suite only; no repository-wide/SDK/kernel-link/hardware readiness claim.

actual_hardware_scope: Saved real observation remains PHY_NOT_READY. No actual chip, BAR, DMA, firmware load, DART initialized or MSI routed fact follows from the fake model.
stop_boundary: One source/host receipt only; no boot packet or hardware authorization.
